newsitem.title: USA: Bay Apartment to place 1.7 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Bay Apartment to place 1.7 mln shares.

text.p: Bay Apartment Communities Inc said on Wednesday it has agreed to sell 1,662,000 shares of common stock to two institutional investors at a price per share of $36.125.
The net proceeds of the deal, after all anticipated issuance costs and commissions, will total $58.7 million, the company said in a statement.
Bay Apartment Communities said it intended to use the proceeds of the offering to repay borrowings under its unsecured line of credit.
"We were able to complete this offering quickly and on highly favorable terms," Gilbert Meyer, Bay's chairman and chief executive officer, said.
He said the transaction would strengthen the company's balance sheet and provide additional resources to fund expansion of the company's portfolio.
The company said the stock sale should close Wednesday.
Bay Apartment Communities is a real estate investment trust that owns 38 apartment communities.
